entries.title: Isaiah 43:1
segments: ¶But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called [thee] by thy name; thou [art] mine.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:2
segments: When thou passest through the waters, I [will be] with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

words.text: , I [will be] with thee; and through the rivers

entries.title: Isaiah 43:3
segments: For I [am] the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt [for] thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:4
segments: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life. {life: or, person}

entries.title: Isaiah 43:5
segments: Fear not: for I [am] with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

words.text: not: for I [am] with thee: I will bring

entries.title: Isaiah 43:6
segments: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

entries.title: Isaiah 43:7
segments: [Even] every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:8
segments: ¶Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:9
segments: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, [It is] truth.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:10
segments: Ye [are] my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I [am] he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me. {no...: or, nothing formed of God}

words.text: me. {no...: or, nothing formed of God}

entries.title: Isaiah 43:11
segments: I, [even] I, [am] the LORD; and beside me [there is] no saviour.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:12
segments: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when [there was] no strange [god] among you: therefore ye [are] my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I [am] God.

words.text: [god] among you: therefore ye [are] my witnesses

entries.title: Isaiah 43:13
segments: Yea, before the day [was] I [am] he; and [there is] none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it? {let it: Heb. turn it back?}

words.text: [was] I [am] he; and [there is] none that can deliver
it? {let it: Heb. turn it back?}

entries.title: Isaiah 43:14
segments: ¶Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry [is] in the ships. {nobles: Heb. bars}

words.text: ; For your sake I have sent

entries.title: Isaiah 43:15
segments: I [am] the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:16
segments: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

entries.title: Isaiah 43:17
segments: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:18
segments: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:19
segments: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, [and] rivers in the desert.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:20
segments: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, [and] rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen. {owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl}

words.text: . {owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl}

entries.title: Isaiah 43:21
segments: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

words.text: for myself; they shall shew forth

entries.title: Isaiah 43:22
segments: ¶But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:23
segments: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense. {small...: Heb. lambs, or, kids}

words.text: . I have not caused thee to serve

entries.title: Isaiah 43:24
segments: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities. {filled...: Heb. made me drunk, or, abundantly moistened}

words.text: : but thou hast made me to serve
. {filled...: Heb. made me drunk, or, abundantly moistened}

entries.title: Isaiah 43:25
segments: I, [even] I, [am] he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

words.text: I, [even] I, [am] he that blotteth out
for mine own sake, and will not remember

entries.title: Isaiah 43:26
segments: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.

words.text: thou, that thou mayest be justified

entries.title: Isaiah 43:27
segments: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me. {teachers: Heb. interpreters}

entries.title: Isaiah 43:28
segments: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches. {princes...: or, holy princes}
